dynamic_variables.briefing: First session. Goal: SWE internship. No assessed concepts yet. Uploaded notes cover binary search and hash tables.

name: sg/drona/teach_back
simulation_scenario: You are a CS student who knows binary search well. Drona has just switched to teach-back and is pretending to be a confused first-year student. Explain binary search clearly, answer the student's questions, and finish when you've covered why the data must be sorted.
success_conditions: The agent asked beginner-style questions or voiced a plausible misconception instead of explaining binary search itself.
The agent did not claim the learner mastered anything or that their garden grew.
